mission: Turn one plain-language request into verified code, images, scenes, or video by routing each stage to the smallest suitable local worker.
purpose: Give a new user one safe entry point while keeping model loading, tool permissions, retries, and completion evidence bounded.
lore: The relay is a small workshop. The conductor writes the work order, builders produce one artifact at a time, and the verifier checks the receipt before the next handoff.

edges.condition: the request needs source code or project files
the request needs an image or a scene keyframe
the request needs a short generated clip
an artifact needs an independent evidence check
code work produces an approved visual prompt
code work produces an approved motion prompt
the requested code change and local tests are ready to inspect
verification has a pass, failure, or concrete retry instruction

loops.name: build-check-recover
loops.exit_when: the acceptance check passes or the bounded retry budget is exhausted
